x: This looks like a fair old field, and it is. Gerry North leads Bob Richardson, Jim Alder, Ron Hill, Tim Johnston, the great Gaston Roelants and Ron Grove in the Coca-Cola 30,000m.

The evergreen Harland (Camb.) led them all home, 10 secs ahead of our second claim member, Bob Richardson (B'Hth). Tony was involved in a mass scramble for the following positions where six seconds covered six runners.

It was a nice touch that while Bob Richardson, the seasoned campaigner and English international from Blackheath Harriers who is wearing our colours second-claim these days, should lead us to victory, the day should have been swung in our favour by M.

In heavy conditions that slowed down this year's times, second-claimer Bob Richardson won our 7½ mile race at a canter from Gerry North who sustained a heavy fall but nevertheless retained his championship.
Congratulations to SALLY and BOB RICHARDSON on the arrival of KATHRYN MARY (weighing in at 7lb 8oz for those to whom such things are meaningful).
John Stow underlined the fact that he is the man of the moment by leading home the claret and gold vests in spite of the welcome presence of Dick Piotrowski and Bob Richardson.
Our old Heathen friend and guest Bob Richardson scored over Colin Pearson and coming into form nicely to take the 'bronze' came Lionel Mann.
With John Bicourt racing on the Continent it fell to Bob Richardson's lot to lead the Bels home. Our packing was not quite what it had been in the earlier two races.
Good packing in the 3rd Surrey League Race. Simon Holmes leads Bob Richardson and Laurie O'Hara with Junior John Searle having a fine run in close attendance.
